        r,g,b = sub[y,x]

        elif r>240 and g>190 and b<160: c='y'  # yellow
        elif r>220 and 120<g<190 and b<120: c='o' # orange
        elif r>200 and g<130 and b<110: c='R'  # red candle
        elif abs(int(r)-int(g))<12 and abs(int(g)-int(b))<12: c='.' # gray wall
        elif r>g+15: c='w' # warm wall glow
        else: c='?'
        row+=c
    print(f'{y+5:3d} {row}')
